name: poplin
description: Publish a folder or one HTML file as a static site on the user's own poplin install: private by default, unlisted or public on request.

interface.shortDescription: Publish static sites to your own poplin install.
interface.longDescription: Fires when the user asks to publish, share, host, or put online a page, a report, a chart, a dashboard, or a folder of static files, or to set poplin up. Publishes with the poplin MCP tools or the poplin command, keeps a new site private, and asks before a site becomes unlisted or public, before its address changes, and before the setup logs in or edits the agent's configuration.
defaultPrompt: Update the report I shared yesterday.
Set up poplin on this computer.
